record_type.description: Kind of dataset record this row represents; post rows use the value post.

source_platform.description: Platform the record was collected from, normally facebook.

provider.description: Normalized identifier of the data provider or collection backend that produced this row.

rank.description: One-based position of this post in the result order of the group run.

group_id.description: Resolved numeric Facebook group ID as a string, or null when it could not be determined.

group_url.description: Public Facebook URL of the group the post was collected from.

group_name.description: Public display name of the Facebook group, or null when not exposed.

source_post_id.description: Stable Facebook post identifier as a string when exposed, otherwise null.

source_url.description: Public permalink URL of the Facebook post, or null when no permalink was exposed.

created_at.description: Facebook publication time of the post as an ISO 8601 timestamp (not the scrape time), or null when unavailable.

created_at_source.description: Provenance of the publication timestamp, such as graphql_creation_time, or null when no timestamp was found.

raw_text.description: Best recovered body text of the post, taken from the direct or nested message; may be an empty string when no text was exposed.

text_source.description: Extraction path that produced the post text, such as direct_message or fallback_nested_message.

text_missing_reason.description: Diagnostic code explaining why no body text was recovered, or null when text is present.

id.description: Author identifier as a string, or null when not exposed.

source_user_id.description: Numeric Facebook user ID of the author as a string, or null when not exposed.

name.description: Public display name of the author, or null when not exposed.

url.description: Public Facebook profile URL of the author, or null when not exposed.

author.description: Public identity of the post author when Facebook exposes it.

stats.description: Best-effort public engagement counters for the post, such as reactions, comments and shares, as integers when exposed.

source_media_id.description: Facebook identifier of the photo as a string, or null when Facebook did not expose one.

media_type.description: Type of media item, normally photo, or null when the type was not exposed.

source_url.description: Direct URL of the full-size public photo, or null when unavailable.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of a smaller public thumbnail for the photo, or null when unavailable.

width.description: Original photo width in pixels, or null when Facebook did not expose it.

height.description: Original photo height in pixels, or null when Facebook did not expose it.

ocr_text.description: Text detected inside the photo by OCR, or null when OCR was not run or found no text.

source.description: Where the media URL was recovered from, such as graphql or html, or null when unknown.

index.description: Zero-based position of the photo in the post's recovered media order.

media.description: List of final recovered public photo objects attached to the post.

media_preview_count.description: Number of valid photo URLs exposed directly in the group feed payload before any media expansion.

media_expanded_count.description: Number of valid photo URLs recovered through additional media expansion requests.

media_final_count.description: Final number of photo objects returned in the media array after deduplication and expansion.

media_completeness.description: Outcome classification of media expansion indicating how completely the post's photos were recovered.

media_completeness_legacy.description: Media completeness value in the older classification scheme, kept for backward compatibility.

media_review_severity.description: Audit signal for how urgently media recovery should be reviewed: none, low, medium or high.

media_plus_n_risk.description: True when Facebook likely hid additional photos behind a "+N" overlay that were not recovered, otherwise false.

attempted.description: True when the deferred media retry was actually executed.

improved.description: True when the deferred retry recovered more media than the previous attempt.

previous.description: Snapshot of media counts and completeness before the deferred retry ran.

final.description: Snapshot of media counts and completeness after the deferred retry finished.

requested_retries.description: Number of retry attempts requested for the deferred media recovery.

retry_delay_ms.description: Delay before the deferred retry, in milliseconds.

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by the deferred retry request, or null when no response was received.

url.description: URL requested during the deferred media retry, or null when no request was made.

error.description: Error message from the deferred media retry, or null when it completed without error.

media_deferred_retry.description: Details of a delayed follow-up attempt to recover missing media, or null when no deferred retry was scheduled.

media_set_tokens.description: Facebook media-set (album) tokens linked to the post and used to expand its photo collection.

coverage_status.description: Reason collection stopped for the row's group, describing how far the group feed was covered.

warnings.description: List of non-fatal diagnostic warning codes or messages raised while processing this post.

pagination.description: Feed pagination state, such as cursor and page position, at the point this post was collected, or null when not applicable.

raw_payload_json.description: Optional parsed source payload for the post, included only when raw payload output is enabled, otherwise null.

raw_comet_payload_json.description: Optional parsed Facebook Comet (web client GraphQL) payload for the post, included only when raw payload output is enabled, otherwise null.
